raw_text: Significant PLA activity detected near Galwan Valley via commercial satellite imagery. New prefab structures, expanded vehicle parks, and helipad construction visible at multiple positions along the Aksai Chin plateau. India responding with mirror deployments. The annual pre-anniversary cycle continues, but this year's scale is notable. Both sides appear to be digging in rather than de-escalating.
